item.title: Ghosts of the rails: The disappearance of Springfield’s hoboes
item.description: SPRINGFIELD, Mo. — For more than half a century, Springfield’s rail yards were a crossroads for hoboes — transient workers who traveled on freight trains in search of work, adventure, or simply a place to sleep. Local newspapers documented their presence, struggles, and eventual disappearance, capturing a slice of American life that has largely vanished. [...]

item.title: Officer-involved shooting under investigation in Springfield
